local channels = {
    "NOTE_OFF",
    "NOTE_ON",
    "POLY_PRESSURE",
    "CONTROL",
    "PROGRAM",
    "CHANNEL_PRESSURE",
    "PITCH_BEND"
}
local texts = {
    "TEXT_EVENT",
    "COPYRIGHT",
    "TRACK_NAME",
    "INSTRUMENT_NAME",
    "LYRIC",
    "MARKER",
    "CUE_POINT"
}
local metas = {
    [0] = "SEQUENCE_NUMBER",
    [32] = "CHANNEL_PREFIX",
    [47] = "END_OF_TRACK",
    [81] = "TEMPO",
    [84] = "SMPTE_OFFSET",
    [88] = "TIME_SIGNATURE",
    [89] = "KEY_SIGNATURE",
    [127] = "SEQUENCER_SPECIFIC"
}
for i, s in ipairs(texts) do
    metas[i] = s
end
local major = {"Cb", "Gb", "Db", "Ab", "Eb", "Bb", "F", "C", "G", "D", "A", "E", "B", "F#", "C#"}
local minor = {"Ab", "Eb", "Bb", "F", "C", "G", "D", "A", "E", "B", "F#", "C#", "G#", "D#", "A#"}
local notes, noteNumbers = {}, {}
local pitches = {"C", "C#", "D", "D#", "E", "F", "F#", "G", "G#", "A", "A#", "B"}
for p = 0, 127 do
    notes[p] = pitches[p % 12 + 1] .. (p // 12 - 1)
    noteNumbers[notes[p]] = p
end
local function copy(v)
    if type(v) ~= "table" then
        return v
    end
    local r = {}
    for k, x in pairs(v) do
        r[k] = copy(x)
    end
    return r
end
local function words(s)
    local r = {}
    for x in (s or ""):gmatch("%S+") do
        r[#r + 1] = x
    end
    return r
end
local function append(a, b)
    for _, x in ipairs(b) do
        a[#a + 1] = x
    end
end
local function integer(a)
    local n = 0
    for _, x in ipairs(a) do
        n = n * 256 + x
    end
    return n
end
local function big(n, count)
    local r = {}
    for i = count, 1, -1 do
        r[i] = n % 256
        n = n // 256
    end
    return r
end
local function vlq(n)
    local r = {n % 128}
    n = n // 128
    while n > 0 do
        table.insert(r, 1, n % 128 + 128)
        n = n // 128
    end
    return r
end
local function bytes(s)
    local r = {}
    for i = 1, #s do
        r[i] = s:byte(i)
    end
    return r
end
local function hex(a)
    local r = {}
    for _, x in ipairs(a) do
        r[#r + 1] = string.format("%02X", x)
    end
    return table.concat(r)
end
local function unhex(s)
    local r = {}
    for x in s:gmatch("..") do
        r[#r + 1] = tonumber(x, 16)
    end
    return r
end
local function eventType(e)
    if e.s < 240 then
        return channels[(e.s >> 4) - 7]
    end
    if e.s ~= 255 then
        return e.s == 240 and "SYSEX" or "SYSEX_ESCAPE"
    end
    return metas[e.m] or "META"
end
local function eventFields(e)
    local d, s = e.d, e.s
    if s < 240 then
        local ch, kind = (s & 15) + 1, s >> 4
        if kind <= 10 then
            return {ch, notes[d[1]], d[2]}
        end
        if kind == 14 then
            return {ch, d[1] + 128 * d[2] - 8192}
        end
        local r = {ch}
        append(r, d)
        return r
    end
    if s ~= 255 or e.m == 127 or not metas[e.m] then
        local r = {}
        if s == 255 and not metas[e.m] then
            r[#r + 1] = string.format("%02X", e.m)
        end
        r[#r + 1] = #d
        if #d > 0 then
            r[#r + 1] = hex(d)
        end
        return r
    end
    if e.m == 0 or e.m == 81 then
        return {integer(d)}
    end
    if e.m >= 1 and e.m <= 7 then
        local r = {}
        for _, x in ipairs(d) do
            r[#r + 1] = string.char(x)
        end
        return {'"' .. table.concat(r) .. '"'}
    end
    if e.m == 32 then
        return {d[1] + 1}
    end
    if e.m == 47 then
        return {}
    end
    if e.m == 84 then
        return d
    end
    if e.m == 88 then
        return {d[1] .. "/" .. (1 << d[2]), d[3], d[4]}
    end
    local sf = d[1] >= 128 and d[1] - 256 or d[1]
    return {(d[2] == 0 and major or minor)[sf + 8], d[2] == 0 and "major" or "minor"}
end
local function eventLine(e, tr)
    local a = {e.t, tr, eventType(e)}
    append(a, eventFields(e))
    return table.concat(a, " ")
end
local function ordered(song)
    local a = {}
    for i, tr in ipairs(song.tracks) do
        for j, e in ipairs(tr) do
            a[#a + 1] = {e = e, tr = i - 1, index = j}
        end
    end
    table.sort(
        a,
        function(x, y)
            if x.e.t ~= y.e.t then
                return x.e.t < y.e.t
            end
            if x.tr ~= y.tr then
                return x.tr < y.tr
            end
            return x.index < y.index
        end
    )
    return a
end
local function length(song)
    local n = 0
    for _, tr in ipairs(song.tracks) do
        n = math.max(n, tr[#tr].t)
    end
    return n
end
local function summary(song)
    local count = 0
    for _, tr in ipairs(song.tracks) do
        count = count + #tr
    end
    return "format " ..
        song.f .. " tracks " .. #song.tracks .. " division " .. song.div .. " events " .. count
end
local function parseHex(data)
    local p, limit, start = 1, #data + 1, 1
    local function fail(reason, pos)
        error("byte " .. (pos - 1) .. ": " .. reason, 0)
    end
    local function read()
        if p >= limit then
            fail("truncated event", start)
        end
        local b = data[p]
        p = p + 1
        return b
    end
    local function variable()
        local at, n = p, 0
        for _ = 1, 4 do
            local b = read()
            n = n * 128 + (b & 127)
            if b < 128 then
                return n
            end
        end
        fail("variable-length value too long", at)
    end
    local function chunk(id)
        local at = p
        if #data - p + 1 < 8 then
            fail("truncated chunk", at)
        end
        for i = 1, 4 do
            if data[p + i - 1] ~= id:byte(i) then
                fail("bad chunk id", at)
            end
        end
        local n = integer({data[p + 4], data[p + 5], data[p + 6], data[p + 7]})
        if p + 8 + n > #data + 1 then
            fail("truncated chunk", at)
        end
        p = p + 8
        return n
    end
    local n = chunk("MThd")
    if n ~= 6 then
        fail("bad header length", 5)
    end
    local f = data[9] * 256 + data[10]
    local count = data[11] * 256 + data[12]
    local division = data[13] * 256 + data[14]
    if f > 2 then
        fail("bad format", 9)
    end
    if count == 0 or (f == 0 and count ~= 1) then
        fail("bad track count", 11)
    end
    if division >= 32768 then
        fail("smpte timing not supported", 13)
    end
    if division == 0 then
        fail("bad division", 13)
    end
    p = 15
    local tracks = {}
    for _ = 1, count do
        if p == #data + 1 then
            fail("missing track", p)
        end
        local size = chunk("MTrk")
        limit = p + size
        local tr, tick, running, ended = {}, 0, nil, false
        while p < limit do
            if ended then
                fail("event after end of track", p)
            end
            start = p
            tick = tick + variable()
            if p >= limit then
                fail("truncated event", start)
            end
            local at, s = p, data[p]
            if s < 128 then
                if not running then
                    fail("data byte without running status", p)
                end
                s = running
            else
                p = p + 1
            end
            local e = {t = tick, s = s, d = {}}
            if s < 240 then
                running = s
                local kind = s >> 4
                for _ = 1, (kind == 12 or kind == 13) and 1 or 2 do
                    local pos, b = p, read()
                    if b >= 128 then
                        fail("bad data byte", pos)
                    end
                    e.d[#e.d + 1] = b
                end
            elseif s == 240 or s == 247 or s == 255 then
                running = nil
                if s == 255 then
                    e.m = read()
                end
                local size = variable()
                if p + size > limit then
                    fail("truncated event", start)
                end
                for _ = 1, size do
                    e.d[#e.d + 1] = read()
                end
                if s == 255 then
                    local fixed = {
                        [0] = 2,
                        [32] = 1,
                        [47] = 0,
                        [81] = 3,
                        [84] = 5,
                        [88] = 4,
                        [89] = 2
                    }
                    if fixed[e.m] and fixed[e.m] ~= size then
                        fail("bad meta length", at)
                    end
                    local d, bad = e.d, false
                    if e.m == 32 then
                        bad = d[1] > 15
                    elseif e.m == 81 then
                        bad = integer(d) == 0
                    elseif e.m == 88 then
                        bad = d[1] == 0 or d[2] > 6
                    elseif e.m == 89 then
                        bad = (d[1] > 7 and d[1] < 249) or d[2] > 1
                    end
                    if bad then
                        fail("bad meta data", at)
                    end
                    ended = e.m == 47
                end
            else
                fail("unknown status byte", at)
            end
            tr[#tr + 1] = e
        end
        if not ended then
            fail("missing end of track", limit)
        end
        tracks[#tracks + 1] = tr
        limit = #data + 1
    end
    if p <= #data then
        fail("extra data", p)
    end
    return {f = f, div = division, tracks = tracks}
end
local function range(s, a, b)
    local n = tonumber(s)
    return n and n >= a and n <= b
end
local function index(a, x)
    for i, v in ipairs(a) do
        if x == v then
            return i
        end
    end
end
local function textEvent(line)
    local tick, tr, kind, rest = line:match("^(%S+) (%S+) (%S+) ?(.*)$")
    local e = {t = tonumber(tick), s = 255, d = {}}
    local ci = index(channels, kind)
    local ti = index(texts, kind)
    local known = ci or ti or kind == "SYSEX" or kind == "SYSEX_ESCAPE" or kind == "META"
    for m, name in pairs(metas) do
        if name == kind then
            e.m = m
            known = true
        end
    end
    if not known then
        error("unknown event type", 0)
    end
    local f, good = words(rest), true
    if ci then
        local k = ci + 7
        good = #f == ((k == 12 or k == 13 or k == 14) and 2 or 3) and range(f[1], 1, 16)
        if k <= 10 then
            good = good and noteNumbers[f[2]] ~= nil and range(f[3], 0, 127)
            e.d = {noteNumbers[f[2]], tonumber(f[3])}
        elseif k == 14 then
            good = good and range(f[2], -8192, 8191)
            local v = (tonumber(f[2]) or 0) + 8192
            e.d = {v % 128, v // 128}
        else
            for i = 2, #f do
                good = good and range(f[i], 0, 127)
                e.d[#e.d + 1] = tonumber(f[i])
            end
        end
        e.s = k * 16 + (tonumber(f[1]) or 1) - 1
    elseif ti then
        good =
            #rest >= 2 and rest:sub(1, 1) == '"' and rest:sub(-1) == '"' and
            not rest:sub(2, -2):find('"', 1, true)
        if good then
            e.d = bytes(rest:sub(2, -2))
        end
    elseif
        kind == "SYSEX" or kind == "SYSEX_ESCAPE" or kind == "SEQUENCER_SPECIFIC" or kind == "META"
     then
        if kind == "META" then
            local tt = table.remove(f, 1)
            good = tt and tt:match("^[0-9A-F][0-9A-F]$") and not metas[tonumber(tt, 16)]
            e.m = tt and tonumber(tt, 16) or nil
        elseif kind ~= "SEQUENCER_SPECIFIC" then
            e.s = kind == "SYSEX" and 240 or 247
        end
        local n = tonumber(f[1]) or -1
        good = good and range(f[1], 0, 1000000) and #f == (n == 0 and 1 or 2)
        if n > 0 then
            good = good and f[2] and #f[2] == 2 * n and f[2]:match("^[0-9A-F]+$")
        end
        if good and n > 0 then
            e.d = unhex(f[2])
        end
    elseif kind == "SEQUENCE_NUMBER" or kind == "TEMPO" or kind == "CHANNEL_PREFIX" then
        local lo, hi = 0, 65535
        if kind == "TEMPO" then
            lo, hi = 1, 16777215
        elseif kind == "CHANNEL_PREFIX" then
            lo, hi = 1, 16
        end
        good = #f == 1 and range(f[1], lo, hi)
        if good then
            e.d =
                kind == "CHANNEL_PREFIX" and {tonumber(f[1]) - 1} or
                big(tonumber(f[1]), kind == "TEMPO" and 3 or 2)
        end
    elseif kind == "END_OF_TRACK" then
        good = #f == 0
    elseif kind == "SMPTE_OFFSET" then
        good = #f == 5
        for _, v in ipairs(f) do
            good = good and range(v, 0, 255)
            e.d[#e.d + 1] = tonumber(v)
        end
    elseif kind == "TIME_SIGNATURE" then
        local nn, dd = (f[1] or ""):match("^(%-?%d+)/(%-?%d+)$")
        local exponent = index({1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 32, 64}, tonumber(dd))
        good =
            #f == 3 and range(nn, 1, 255) and exponent and range(f[2], 0, 255) and
            range(f[3], 0, 255)
        if good then
            e.d = {tonumber(nn), exponent - 1, tonumber(f[2]), tonumber(f[3])}
        end
    elseif kind == "KEY_SIGNATURE" then
        local keys = f[2] == "major" and major or minor
        local i = index(keys, f[1])
        good = #f == 2 and (f[2] == "major" or f[2] == "minor") and i
        if good then
            e.d = {(i - 8) % 256, f[2] == "major" and 0 or 1}
        end
    end
    if not good then
        error("bad value", 0)
    end
    return e, tonumber(tr)
end
local function parseText(lines)
    local h = words(lines[1])
    if
        #h ~= 4 or h[1] ~= "HEADER" or not range(h[2], 0, 2) or not range(h[3], 1, 65535) or
            not range(h[4], 1, 32767) or
            (tonumber(h[2]) == 0 and tonumber(h[3]) ~= 1)
     then
        error("line 1: bad header", 0)
    end
    local count, tracks, c = tonumber(h[3]), {{}}, 1
    for i = 2, #lines do
        local ok, e, tr = pcall(textEvent, lines[i])
        if not ok then
            error("line " .. i .. ": " .. e, 0)
        end
        local reason
        local ended = #tracks[c] > 0 and eventType(tracks[c][#tracks[c]]) == "END_OF_TRACK"
        if tr >= count then
            reason = "bad track"
        elseif tr < c - 1 then
            reason = "out of order"
        elseif tr > c - 1 and (not ended or tr > c) then
            reason = "missing end of track"
        elseif tr == c - 1 and ended then
            reason = "event after end of track"
        end
        if reason then
            error("line " .. i .. ": " .. reason, 0)
        end
        if tr == c then
            c = c + 1
            tracks[c] = {}
        end
        if #tracks[c] > 0 and e.t < tracks[c][#tracks[c]].t then
            error("line " .. i .. ": out of order", 0)
        end
        tracks[c][#tracks[c] + 1] = e
    end
    if c < count or #tracks[c] == 0 or eventType(tracks[c][#tracks[c]]) ~= "END_OF_TRACK" then
        error("line " .. (#lines + 1) .. ": missing end of track", 0)
    end
    return {f = tonumber(h[2]), div = tonumber(h[4]), tracks = tracks}
end
local function pairing(song)
    local queues, paired, unmatched = {}, {}, {}
    for order, item in ipairs(ordered(song)) do
        local e = item.e
        local k = e.s >> 4
        if k == 8 or k == 9 then
            local key = (e.s & 15) * 128 + e.d[1]
            local on = k == 9 and e.d[2] > 0
            local a = {e = e, tr = item.tr, order = order, on = on}
            queues[key] = queues[key] or {}
            if on then
                queues[key][#queues[key] + 1] = a
            elseif #queues[key] == 0 then
                unmatched[#unmatched + 1] = a
            else
                local first = table.remove(queues[key], 1)
                paired[#paired + 1] = {
                    on = first.e,
                    off = e,
                    order = first.order,
                    start = first.e.t,
                    length = e.t - first.e.t,
                    ch = (e.s & 15) + 1,
                    p = e.d[1],
                    v = first.e.d[2]
                }
            end
        end
    end
    for _, q in pairs(queues) do
        append(unmatched, q)
    end
    table.sort(
        paired,
        function(a, b)
            if a.start ~= b.start then
                return a.start < b.start
            end
            if a.ch ~= b.ch then
                return a.ch < b.ch
            end
            if a.p ~= b.p then
                return a.p < b.p
            end
            return a.order < b.order
        end
    )
    table.sort(
        unmatched,
        function(a, b)
            return a.order < b.order
        end
    )
    return paired, unmatched
end
local function timePosition(song, tick)
    local s, last, v, st, bar, nn, beat = 0, 0, 500000, 0, 1, 4, song.div
    for _, item in ipairs(ordered(song)) do
        local e = item.e
        if e.t > tick then
            break
        end
        if e.s == 255 and e.m == 81 then
            s = s + (e.t - last) * v
            last, v = e.t, integer(e.d)
        elseif e.s == 255 and e.m == 88 then
            local size = nn * beat
            bar = bar + (e.t - st + size - 1) // size
            st, nn, beat = e.t, e.d[1], math.max(1, song.div * 4 // (1 << e.d[2]))
        end
    end
    local micro, x = (s + (tick - last) * v) // song.div, tick - st
    return micro // 1000 .. "." .. string.format("%03d", micro % 1000), bar + x // (nn * beat) ..
        ":" .. x % (nn * beat) // beat + 1 .. ":" .. x % beat
end
local function encode(song, running, noteoff)
    local result = bytes("MThd")
    append(result, big(6, 4))
    append(result, big(song.f, 2))
    append(result, big(#song.tracks, 2))
    append(result, big(song.div, 2))
    for _, tr in ipairs(song.tracks) do
        local data, last, status = {}, 0, nil
        for _, e in ipairs(tr) do
            append(data, vlq(e.t - last))
            last = e.t
            local s, d = e.s, copy(e.d)
            if noteoff == "ZERO" and s >> 4 == 8 then
                s = s + 16
                d[2] = 0
            end
            if s < 240 then
                if not running or status ~= s then
                    data[#data + 1] = s
                end
                append(data, d)
                status = s
            else
                status = nil
                data[#data + 1] = s
                if s == 255 then
                    data[#data + 1] = e.m
                end
                append(data, vlq(#d))
                append(data, d)
            end
        end
        append(result, bytes("MTrk"))
        append(result, big(#data, 4))
        append(result, data)
    end
    for i = 1, #result, 16 do
        local a = {}
        for j = i, math.min(i + 15, #result) do
            a[#a + 1] = string.format("%02X", result[j])
        end
        print(string.format("%04X: ", i - 1) .. table.concat(a, " "))
    end
    print(#result .. " bytes")
end
local songs, running, noteoff = {}, true, "KEEP"
local known = {}
for _, c in ipairs(
    words(
        "HEX TEXT DECODE ENCODE TIMING NOTES STATS ROLL TRANSPOSE QUANTIZE VELOCITY TEMPO FILTER MERGE SPLIT COPY LIST RUNNING NOTEOFF"
    )
) do
    known[c] = true
end
local function requireThat(valid, message)
    if not valid then
        error(message, 0)
    end
end
local function run(line)
    local a = words(line)
    local cmd = table.remove(a, 1)
    local name = a[1]
    requireThat(known[cmd], "unknown command")
    if cmd == "HEX" or cmd == "TEXT" then
        local lines = {}
        for _ = 1, tonumber(a[2]) do
            lines[#lines + 1] = io.read()
        end
        local song
        if cmd == "TEXT" then
            song = parseText(lines)
        else
            local data = {}
            for _, b in ipairs(words(table.concat(lines, " "))) do
                data[#data + 1] = tonumber(b, 16)
            end
            song = parseHex(data)
        end
        songs[name] = song
        print("loaded " .. name .. " " .. summary(song))
        return
    end
    if cmd ~= "LIST" and cmd ~= "RUNNING" and cmd ~= "NOTEOFF" then
        requireThat(songs[name], "no song " .. name)
    end
    local song = songs[name]
    if cmd == "LIST" then
        local keys = {}
        for k in pairs(songs) do
            keys[#keys + 1] = k
        end
        table.sort(keys)
        if #keys == 0 then
            print("no songs")
        end
        for _, k in ipairs(keys) do
            print(k .. " " .. summary(songs[k]))
        end
    elseif cmd == "RUNNING" or cmd == "NOTEOFF" then
        requireThat(
            cmd == "RUNNING" and (name == "ON" or name == "OFF") or
                cmd == "NOTEOFF" and (name == "ZERO" or name == "KEEP"),
            "bad argument"
        )
        if cmd == "RUNNING" then
            running = name == "ON"
        else
            noteoff = name
        end
        print(cmd:lower() .. " " .. name:lower())
    elseif cmd == "COPY" then
        songs[a[2]] = copy(song)
        print("copied " .. name .. " to " .. a[2])
    elseif cmd == "DECODE" then
        print("HEADER " .. song.f .. " " .. #song.tracks .. " " .. song.div)
        for i, tr in ipairs(song.tracks) do
            for _, e in ipairs(tr) do
                print(eventLine(e, i - 1))
            end
        end
    elseif cmd == "ENCODE" then
        encode(song, running, noteoff)
    elseif cmd == "TIMING" then
        requireThat(song.f ~= 2, "format 2 not supported")
        for _, item in ipairs(ordered(song)) do
            local tm, pos = timePosition(song, item.e.t)
            print(item.e.t .. " " .. item.tr .. " " .. eventType(item.e) .. " " .. tm .. " " .. pos)
        end
        local tm, pos = timePosition(song, length(song))
        print("end " .. length(song) .. " " .. tm .. " " .. pos)
    elseif cmd == "NOTES" or cmd == "STATS" or cmd == "ROLL" then
        local from, to, step = tonumber(a[2]), tonumber(a[3]), tonumber(a[4])
        if cmd == "ROLL" then
            requireThat(
                range(a[2], 0, 10000000) and range(a[3], 1, 10000000) and range(a[4], 1, 10000000) and
                    to > from and
                    (to - from + step - 1) // step <= 64,
                "bad argument"
            )
        elseif cmd == "STATS" then
            requireThat(song.f ~= 2, "format 2 not supported")
        end
        local ns, unmatched = pairing(song)
        if cmd == "NOTES" then
            print("notes " .. #ns .. " unmatched " .. #unmatched)
            for _, n in ipairs(ns) do
                print(n.start .. " " .. n.length .. " " .. n.ch .. " " .. notes[n.p] .. " " .. n.v)
            end
            for _, u in ipairs(unmatched) do
                print(
                    "unmatched " ..
                        (u.on and "on" or "off") ..
                            " " ..
                                u.e.t ..
                                    " " .. u.tr .. " " .. (u.e.s & 15) + 1 .. " " .. notes[u.e.d[1]]
                )
            end
        elseif cmd == "ROLL" then
            local found = false
            for p = 127, 0, -1 do
                local chars, visible = {}, false
                for i = 0, (to - from + step - 1) // step - 1 do
                    local at, c = from + i * step, "."
                    for _, n in ipairs(ns) do
                        if n.p == p and n.start <= at and at < n.start + n.length then
                            c = "="
                        end
                    end
                    for _, n in ipairs(ns) do
                        if n.p == p and at <= n.start and n.start < at + step then
                            c = "#"
                        end
                    end
                    chars[#chars + 1] = c
                    if c ~= "." then
                        visible = true
                    end
                end
                if visible then
                    print(string.format("%-4s ", notes[p]) .. table.concat(chars))
                    found = true
                end
            end
            if not found then
                print("empty")
            end
        else
            print(summary(song))
            print("notes " .. #ns .. " unmatched " .. #unmatched)
            local low, high, changes = 128, -1, {}
            for ch = 1, 16 do
                local count, lo, hi = 0, 128, -1
                for _, n in ipairs(ns) do
                    if n.ch == ch then
                        count = count + 1
                        lo, hi = math.min(lo, n.p), math.max(hi, n.p)
                    end
                end
                if count > 0 then
                    print(
                        "channel " ..
                            ch .. " notes " .. count .. " range " .. notes[lo] .. " " .. notes[hi]
                    )
                    low, high = math.min(low, lo), math.max(high, hi)
                end
            end
            print(#ns == 0 and "range none" or "range " .. notes[low] .. " " .. notes[high])
            local tm = timePosition(song, length(song))
            print("length " .. length(song) .. " ticks " .. tm .. " ms")
            for _, n in ipairs(ns) do
                if n.length > 0 then
                    changes[n.start] = (changes[n.start] or 0) + 1
                    changes[n.start + n.length] = (changes[n.start + n.length] or 0) - 1
                end
            end
            local ticks = {}
            for t in pairs(changes) do
                ticks[#ticks + 1] = t
            end
            table.sort(ticks)
            local active, maximum, at = 0, 0, 0
            for _, t in ipairs(ticks) do
                active = active + changes[t]
                if active > maximum then
                    maximum, at = active, t
                end
            end
            print(maximum == 0 and "polyphony 0" or "polyphony " .. maximum .. " at " .. at)
        end
    elseif cmd == "TRANSPOSE" then
        requireThat(range(a[2], -127, 127) and (not a[3] or range(a[3], 1, 16)), "bad argument")
        local amount, ch, kept, dropped = tonumber(a[2]), tonumber(a[3]), 0, {}
        for i, tr in ipairs(song.tracks) do
            local new = {}
            for _, e in ipairs(tr) do
                local kind = e.s >> 4
                if kind >= 8 and kind <= 10 and (not ch or (e.s & 15) + 1 == ch) then
                    local p = e.d[1] + amount
                    if p < 0 or p > 127 then
                        dropped[#dropped + 1] =
                            "dropped " ..
                            e.t ..
                                " " ..
                                    i - 1 ..
                                        " " ..
                                            eventType(e) ..
                                                " " .. (e.s & 15) + 1 .. " " .. notes[e.d[1]]
                    else
                        e.d[1] = p
                        kept = kept + 1
                        new[#new + 1] = e
                    end
                else
                    new[#new + 1] = e
                end
            end
            song.tracks[i] = new
        end
        print("transposed " .. kept .. " dropped " .. #dropped)
        for _, s in ipairs(dropped) do
            print(s)
        end
    elseif cmd == "QUANTIZE" then
        requireThat(range(a[2], 1, 1000000) and range(a[3], 0, 100), "bad argument")
        local grid, strength = tonumber(a[2]), tonumber(a[3])
        local ns, unmatched = pairing(song)
        local targets, moved = {}, 0
        for _, n in ipairs(ns) do
            targets[#targets + 1] = {n.on, n.off}
        end
        for _, u in ipairs(unmatched) do
            if u.on then
                targets[#targets + 1] = {u.e}
            end
        end
        for _, events in ipairs(targets) do
            local t = events[1].t
            local lower = t // grid * grid
            local g = t - lower <= lower + grid - t and lower or lower + grid
            local delta = (2 * (g - t) * strength + 100) // 200
            if delta ~= 0 then
                moved = moved + 1
            end
            for _, e in ipairs(events) do
                e.t = e.t + delta
            end
        end
        for _, tr in ipairs(song.tracks) do
            local ending = table.remove(tr)
            for i, e in ipairs(tr) do
                e.order = i
            end
            table.sort(
                tr,
                function(x, y)
                    return x.t < y.t or x.t == y.t and x.order < y.order
                end
            )
            for _, e in ipairs(tr) do
                ending.t = math.max(ending.t, e.t)
                e.order = nil
            end
            tr[#tr + 1] = ending
        end
        print("quantized " .. #targets .. " moved " .. moved)
    elseif cmd == "VELOCITY" then
        requireThat(range(a[2], 0, 1000) and range(a[3], -127, 127), "bad argument")
        local count, clamped = 0, 0
        for _, item in ipairs(ordered(song)) do
            local e = item.e
            if e.s >> 4 == 9 and e.d[2] > 0 then
                count = count + 1
                local v = (e.d[2] * tonumber(a[2]) + 50) // 100 + tonumber(a[3])
                if v < 1 or v > 127 then
                    clamped = clamped + 1
                end
                e.d[2] = math.max(1, math.min(127, v))
            end
        end
        print("velocity " .. count .. " clamped " .. clamped)
    elseif cmd == "TEMPO" then
        requireThat(range(a[2], 1, 1000) and range(a[3], 1, 1000), "bad argument")
        local num, den, converted, insert = tonumber(a[2]), tonumber(a[3]), {}, true
        for _, item in ipairs(ordered(song)) do
            local e = item.e
            if e.s == 255 and e.m == 81 then
                local v = (2 * integer(e.d) * den + num) // (2 * num)
                requireThat(v >= 1 and v <= 16777215, "tempo out of range")
                converted[#converted + 1] = {e, v}
                if e.t == 0 then
                    insert = false
                end
            end
        end
        local v = (1000000 * den + num) // (2 * num)
        requireThat(not insert or v >= 1 and v <= 16777215, "tempo out of range")
        for _, pair in ipairs(converted) do
            pair[1].d = big(pair[2], 3)
        end
        print("scaled " .. #converted)
        if insert then
            table.insert(song.tracks[1], 1, {t = 0, s = 255, m = 81, d = big(v, 3)})
            print("inserted 0 0 TEMPO " .. v)
        end
    elseif cmd == "FILTER" then
        local allowed = {}
        for i = 2, #a do
            requireThat(range(a[i], 1, 16), "bad argument")
            allowed[tonumber(a[i])] = true
        end
        local count = 0
        for _, tr in ipairs(song.tracks) do
            for i = #tr, 1, -1 do
                if tr[i].s < 240 and not allowed[(tr[i].s & 15) + 1] then
                    table.remove(tr, i)
                    count = count + 1
                end
            end
        end
        print("removed " .. count)
    elseif cmd == "MERGE" then
        requireThat(song.f == 1, "not format 1")
        local count, ending, tr = #song.tracks, length(song), {}
        for _, item in ipairs(ordered(song)) do
            if eventType(item.e) ~= "END_OF_TRACK" then
                tr[#tr + 1] = item.e
            end
        end
        tr[#tr + 1] = {t = ending, s = 255, m = 47, d = {}}
        song.f, song.tracks = 0, {tr}
        print("merged " .. count .. " tracks events " .. #tr)
    elseif cmd == "SPLIT" then
        requireThat(song.f == 0, "not format 0")
        local tr, groups = song.tracks[1], {[-1] = {}}
        for i = 1, #tr - 1 do
            local e = tr[i]
            local key = e.s < 240 and (e.s & 15) or -1
            groups[key] = groups[key] or {}
            groups[key][#groups[key] + 1] = e
        end
        local result, count = {}, 0
        for key = -1, 15 do
            if groups[key] then
                local group = groups[key]
                group[#group + 1] = copy(tr[#tr])
                result[#result + 1] = group
                count = count + #group
            end
        end
        song.f, song.tracks = 1, result
        print("split tracks " .. #result .. " events " .. count)
    end
end
local n = tonumber(io.read())
for _ = 1, n do
    local ok, message = pcall(run, io.read())
    if not ok then
        print("error: " .. message)
    end
end
